subject.title: fix(google): import official Gemini CLI OAuth cache

question: Should OpenClaw retire its current Gemini OAuth flow, and if so which supported official Gemini CLI interface should own credential handoff now that current credentials live in keychain-backed storage?
rationale: The proposed private-file boundary is obsolete upstream; selecting a durable replacement or deciding to retain the current flow requires provider ownership and product intent rather than a mechanical patch.

options.title: Keep current OAuth temporarily
options.body: Retain the existing OpenClaw flow until a supported official credential handoff is available and proven across fresh and upgraded setups.

options.title: Delegate through official CLI
options.body: Design a provider-owned runtime or explicit export interface that leaves private Gemini CLI credential storage untouched.

recommendation.title: Keep current OAuth temporarily
recommendation.body: Retain the existing OpenClaw flow until a supported official credential handoff is available and proven across fresh and upgraded setups.

likelyOwner.reason: The current provider implementation and recent Google plugin architecture changes trace primarily to this contributor.
